rules_text: CHANNEL RULES (Core Realty, Dubai real estate): English on-screen titles are primary. Numbers and currency on screen must match the voice-over and the facts. Area, community and developer names are spelled the way the developer / Dubai Land Department (DLD) writes them (Emaar, DAMAC, Sobha, JVC, Palm Jebel Ali, Business Bay…). Lower thirds are consistent: Name · role · company. Arabic signage in real-world b-roll is NOT an error. Do not nitpick currency FORMAT — both «AED 2M» and «500K+ AED» appear in channel graphics; flag only a wrong number, a wrong currency, or a mismatch with the voice-over. Taste, layout and pacing are never edit notes.
